name: The Dine and Dance
source:
You finally got your friends to go to a club you've been exited to try, the Dine and Dance; a niche little club/restaurant popular with the working class. Problem is, none of them are up for dancing today, and that's half the reason you came. You might have to take matters into your own hands, and maybe meet someone who may or may not be [s]a criminal[/s] an absolute cutie pie!

[From [url=https://cereal-munching-cat.itch.io/dine-and-dance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你终于让你的朋友们去了一个你一直想尝试的俱乐部——晚餐和舞蹈俱乐部；受工人阶级欢迎的小众小俱乐部/餐厅。问题是，他们今天都不适合跳舞，而这就是你来的一半原因。你可能必须自己处理事情，也许会遇到一个可能是也可能不是[s]罪犯的人[/s]绝对是可爱的馅饼！

[来自[url=https://cereal-munching-cat.itch.io/dine-and-dance]itch.io[/url]]
